description: A trained probe's direction, projected out of the stream it was trained on, in one document, on the tiny GPT-2 the byte-level BPE documents use. Twenty one-sentence reviews, half positive and half negative, end "Overall, the movie was"; `harvest.h` reads layer 2's output at that last token, and the fit trains a two-class `linear` probe on it against `label` (its classes sorted: `negative`, then `positive`). `fit.probe.W` is the trained probe's weight, a value laid out `[hidden_size, classes]`: `positive` and `negative` select its two columns (a `select` keeps `classes` at size 1, labelled with the class it kept), each summed over `classes` to drop that axis, and `direction` is the one less the other, `W[:, 1] - W[:, 0]`, the direction along which the probe tells positive from negative. `projected` removes it from layer 2's output at every position (`project_out`), and `null` removes the direction scaled to zero, which leaves every vector as it is, so its numbers are the clean run's to the bit. `ld` is each row's logit for its `answer` less its `other` (" well" and " no", one token each on this tokenizer), and each `margin` its mean over the rows. The weights are random, so the probe and the margins show the mechanism, not a sentiment; the probe is trained and its direction tested on the same twenty rows.
